correctness.rationale: Each k-subspace has a unique reduced-row-echelon generator. For each pivot pattern all free nonpivot bits are enumerated and every codeword and its distinct deletion outputs checked. For k+1 excluded at each n, no larger subspace can pass because list-size-two is inherited by subcodes. Independently compiled C++ gave 10,795 tested n=8,k=6, 788,035 tested n=9,k=6 and 6,347,715 tested n=10,k=7, zero admissible in all; the source RREF exhaustion counts and witness dimensions for n<=9 are inspected. At n=10 the explicit rank-six matrix has deletion parent histogram exactly (220,232,60), and direct independent check verified this. Exhaustion is only for declared n,k, not all lengths.
